verdicts.reason: needs undocumented step: npm run build (its prebuild scripts/names.mjs writes site/src/generated/names.json) before the source-map build. As stated, after npm ci only, the astro build exits 1 rendering /atlas/A1 ('names.json has no typeset name for "A1"'), so the classify count has nothing to run on. With that step added, the counts equal the finding's (3 on load, 2 per pick); this is recorded in evidence for the owner and is not part of the verdict.

verdicts.reason: reproduced as stated; observed matches: in two alternated A/B runs at load 4 to 11, the C8 node 7 link and the E7 node 7 control hydrate in tasks of the same length (medians 34.6 to 48.3 ms against 39.6 to 45.1, individual tasks 31.8 to 69.3) in G5 and G6 alike.
